title: Three Sibling Children Crouching on Lawn, c. 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
2478

This one is rather fuzzy. Steve didn't like being held down - as he is obviously being held.
description: A charming mid-century black and white deckle-edged snapshot showing three young siblings crouching close together on a grassy lawn next to a large flowering shrub. The older boy and girl attempt to keep their squirming younger toddler brother, Steve, still for the picture. The handwritten note on the back provides humorous context for the slight blur, explaining the toddler's spirited resistance to being held down.
